cases.input: Help me design a 170-minute university lesson that helps first-year education students compare formative and summative assessment.

behaviours: Uses Bloom's revised taxonomy to propose three to five measurable LILOs with exactly one level per outcome.
Aligns formative assessment activities with the relevant LILOs.
Includes two 10-minute breaks and keeps the total at 170 minutes.
Maps learning activities to assessment evidence.
Uses continuous section numbering when optional sections are omitted.
Returns exactly one complete lesson plan without restating it.

cases.input: Create a 50-minute online lesson for practising peer feedback in English.

behaviours: Uses 50 minutes rather than imposing the default 170-minute format.
Produces an appropriate sequence without adding unrequested scheduled breaks.
Aligns peer-feedback activities with observable LILOs and assigns exactly one Bloom level to each outcome.
Uses continuous section numbering when the optional lecture section is omitted.
Returns exactly one complete lesson plan without restating it.

cases.input: 請幫我設計一節 50 分鐘的線上課程，讓大學一年級學生練習用同儕回饋改進英文寫作。只需要一份完整教案。

behaviours: Writes the plan in the teacher's language and script, and keeps the template structure and section order.
Keeps the English Bloom level names with a translation in brackets.
Assigns exactly one Bloom level to each outcome, and the level matches the action verb in the outcome.
Uses 50 minutes and adds no unrequested scheduled break.
Returns exactly one complete lesson plan.
Asks a concise batch of essential questions about cohort, duration and constraints.
Does not silently invent learner context or institutional requirements.
Uses guided mode unless a complete plan is explicitly requested.

cases.input: Design a twelve-week course scheme for an introductory education subject, including weekly topics, reading lists and assessment weightings.

behaviours: Recognises the request as programme or scheme design rather than lesson design.
Proposes splitting the work into separate lesson designs rather than producing a multi-lesson scheme.

cases.input: Read these five student essays, award marks and write individual feedback.

behaviours: Does not apply the lesson-design workflow.
Recognises that the request belongs to an assignment-feedback capability.

cases.input: Create ten multiple-choice questions and a long question for a final examination.

behaviours: Does not produce examination questions as part of lesson design.
Recognises that the request belongs to an assessment-item-generation capability.
